metadata.benchmark: master binary multi-run JAX FFI vs microLUX
metadata.reference_policy: all value-accuracy errors use the runbook VBM RelTol=1e-6 values; lane target controls kernel/microLUX timing setting

timing_patterns.values_plus_dA_dt: forward block + separate synchronized dA/dt block

q_rho_bins.coverage_note: block rows have two or more rows per cell; four reference epochs per block give the runbook's minimum population of eight for epoch-level maps

dA_dt_cross_engine_disagreement.definition: abs(FFI dA/dt - microLUX dA/dt) / max(abs(FFI dA/dt), 1)
dA_dt_cross_engine_disagreement.interpretation: diagnostic only; no VBM dA/dt reference is present in the runbook

accuracy_against_vbm_reltol_1e-6.derivative_reference: unavailable in the runbook; dA/dt is timed and cross-engine comparison only
